note: Sanitized record of ProofOS on Google Cloud Run. No credentials, tokens, or key material.

reproducibility.note: Images tagged with the short commit SHA; tag ba2aab5 is a real repo commit.

d17_resolution.problem: The collector could only reach anonymous endpoints, so on Cloud Run it observed its own health endpoint instead of the service under scrutiny.
d17_resolution.fix: The collector presents its own Cloud Run service identity (Google OIDC) when a server-owned profile declares the target protected. It never receives or reuses the caller's credential.
d17_resolution.fail_closed: Failure to obtain a token raises; it never falls back to an anonymous probe.

executor_tool_bound.problem: A live run invoked perform_action seven times for a single-step task.
executor_tool_bound.fix: The runtime caps how often the action actually runs; past the ceiling the tool truthfully reports the work is already done rather than erroring.

evidence.note: signed attestation from authenticated cross-service probe

live_gemini_cloud.status: PROVEN BEFORE THE D17 FIX ONLY
live_gemini_cloud.caveat: That run predates the cross-service fix; the collector observed its own health endpoint. A live run WITH the fix is NOT PROVEN -- both attempts hit the Gemini free-tier daily quota (20 requests/day).

known_limitations: Cloud Run's front end intercepts /healthz and returns HTML 404; /health is used instead.
Cloud Run request timeout raised to 900s because live turns with pacing exceed the 300s default.
